scripts.build: npm run build -w @researchx/shared && npm run build -w @researchx/api && npm run build -w @researchx/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @researchx/shared && npm run dev -w @researchx/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @researchx/shared && npm run dev -w @researchx/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @researchx/shared && python3 -m pytest services/ingest/tests -q
scripts.migrate: npm run build -w @researchx/shared && npm run migrate -w @researchx/api
